subject: general
question: A man’s monthly income is ₹50,000. He spends 25% of it on tax, 30% of the remaining income on household expenses, and 10% of the still remaining income on entertainment. He saves the remaining part of his income. How much money will the man save per year, assuming that the above data is same for all 12 months?
solution:
**Given:**

A man's monthly income = ₹50,000

He spends 25% of it on tax

30% of the remaining income on household expenses

10% of the still remaining income on entertainment

**Formula Used:**

Savings = Monthly income - (Tax + Household expenses + Entertainment expenses)

**Calculation:**

Monthly income = ₹50,000

Tax = 25% of ₹50,000

Tax = 25/100 × 50,000

⇒ Tax = ₹12,500
